note: Inside a data RECORD, an ordinary (non-@) FIELD label resets @-local-label scope, exactly like a code label — so an `@label` reused under successive field labels stays DISTINCT rather than collapsing to one record-wide scope. define_label previously guarded the last_global update with `and not self.cur_record`, deliberately NOT resetting @-scope at record fields; that was wrong (MPW resets @-scope at every non-@ label). A field's bare name is still not defined as a global symbol (_is_record_field), only its @-scope-delimiting role changed. discovered: StyleWriter dialogdata.a DialogDataRec reuses @TitleStart/@TitleEnd under heightTitleItem/pagesTitleItem/pagesFromToSeparatorItem/copiesTitleItem, each `dc.l @TitleStart` + `dc.w @TitleEnd-@TitleStart`; also fixes ImageWriter/LQ dialog residuals. Expected: itemA length 2 ('AA'), itemB length 3 ('BBB'), the two @s at distinct offsets 6 and 14.
